inputs.text: Listen, don't fall for the line that this brick kiln mess in Uttar Pradesh is just some bureaucratic slip-up or honest delay. Three months after the environmental clearances were mandated, they're still insisting they can't set up any clear process, leaving the whole industry in confusion and limbo. That's the official story they're pushing. What it's really about is coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions that benefit from trapping the small operators in their rigged system. The kiln owners already hold approvals from the State Pollution Control Board for water and air standards, but now they're being hit with extra clearances deliberately kept murky to bring in middlemen for interference and control. It's not incompetence—it's the exact tool they use to enforce compliance while shielding their insiders. Legal experts demanding that court decisions be followed are just propping up the operation, selling it as neutral rules when it's really about narrative control and using the environmental excuse to deliberately weaken the industry. The entire delay is set up to serve those concealed interests, not to improve anything for the environment or the operators.
